body.name: Canonical CPDAG with block-family background arrows
body.construction: Let \(\operatorname{CPDAG}(G)\) denote the ordinary completed partially directed acyclic graph whose consistent DAG extensions are the Markov-equivalence class of \(G\). Define \(\mathcal P_C\) by retaining every directed edge of \(\operatorname{CPDAG}(G)\) and, for every adjacency whose orientation belongs to \(F(C)\), inserting that orientation from \(G\); every remaining unoriented adjacency stays undirected. The construction does not require \(\mathcal P_C\) to be maximally oriented; its Meek closure is the corresponding MPDAG with the same consistent extensions.
